verdict.rationale: GitHub's own site states almost word-for-word what the story asks: "Launch a full, cloud-based development environment in seconds." However, this is a single marketing tagline with no supporting documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the cloud dev environment feature, evidence of ready-to-code configuration (prebuilt or preconfigured environments), and independent confirmation of the "in seconds" launch claim.
